basic_profile.bio: I'm a 33-year-old fan fiction enthusiast living in a cozy apartment in Athens, Greece. My interests range from writing and reading fan fiction to exploring the beautiful landscapes and rich history of Greece. By day, I work as a freelance writer and editor, which allows me the flexibility to indulge in my passion for storytelling. I am in a long-term relationship with my partner, who is very supportive of my creative endeavors. My typical online hours are late evenings, when I unwind from the day and dive into the world of fiction.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Literature and have spent years honing my writing skills through online courses and self-study. My work as a freelance writer has also contributed significantly to my expertise in storytelling and editing.
